name: mahyar-gap
description: Mahyar Gap — private group communication space (chat, voice, video, screen share, live radio) built for a small circle of friends

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mahyar/api && npm run build -w @mahyar/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mahyar/api && npm run lint -w @mahyar/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mahyar/api && npm run test -w @mahyar/web
